title: Mildred saves Duke's finances; Bea and Willie Bryant
summary: Mildred gave Duke her salary to pay the band when he gambled and he treated her badly; when the Cotton Club moved to Broadway he took up with Bea, who had been with Willie Bryant and Joe Louis.

blocks.x: So they were dancing at the Cotton Club?
Yeah.
And that's where she and Duke met?
Yeah.
And that was --

She saved Duke. Duke used to gamble, you know, and sometimes he didn't have enough money to pay off the boys in the band and she'd give him her salary to pay off. And he treated her badly. He was terrible.
They were together about 10 years, weren't they?
Pretty long, but I don't think 10 years, no. But they were a long time together.
Until he took up with Bea?
Yeah. That's later.
Was that when he left Mildred, was when he met Bea?

Yeah, well, they fell out, and when the Cotton Club moved down to Broadway, that's when he took up with Bea. And Bea used to be with -- oh, God. He was out here. He was the emcee and everything. He looked like a white boy and he stayed, lived mostly out in Pasadena. He was the emcee at the Apollo Theater.
Leonard Reed?
Not Leonard.
Willie Bryant?
Willie Bryant.
She had gone with him before?

Oh, yeah. He used to beat the beJesus out of her. And he didn't have any prize there, you know, because she -- she went with Joe Louis at one time and I caught her in Detroit with Joe Louis. She was no prize at all.
But yet he kept her as a housekeeper to the end?
Yeah, he kept her. What else he's going to do?
